name: Tarcoat Deckhand
description: A soot-dark deckhand with a cutlass, rope harness, and pitch-stained coat.

name: Saltwind Cutlass Raider
description: A fast boarding raider with a salt-bleached scarf and nicked cutlass.

name: Blackpowder Pistolier
description: A lean flintlock gunner with a brass powder flask and split-tail coat.

name: Boarding Pike Corsair
description: An armored corsair bracing a long hooked boarding pike across the body.

name: Chainhook Climber
description: A rope rigger with a grappling chain, climbing gloves, and a wind-whipped hood.

name: Gale-Glass Harpooner
description: A broad-shouldered harpooner in flight goggles with a compact deck harpoon.

name: Powder-Keg Runner
description: A nimble fuse runner with a satchel of sealed powder charges and a short blade.

name: Crow's Nest Sharpshooter
description: A patient long-gun marksman wearing a narrow brim, brass sight, and feathered mantle.

name: Rift-Compass Navigator
description: A grim route-finder holding a violet-lit compass under a layered chart cloak.

name: Sky-Chart Thief
description: A narrow figure with stolen charts, a half-mask, and two slim boarding knives.

name: Quartermaster Breaker
description: A stocky quartermaster with a heavy boarding axe and iron-reinforced leather.

name: Red-Sash Duelist
description: A precise duelist with a swept-back hat, red sash, and long narrow sabre.

name: Brass-Mask Ship Surgeon
description: A masked field surgeon with a hooked knife, leather apron, and brass breathing mask.

name: Cinderbomb Grenadier
description: A black-gloved bomber with a short blunderbuss, fuse braid, and smoke-dark coat.

name: Black-Banner Standard Bearer
description: A stern banner carrier with a violet-edged pennant and a boarding sword.

name: Hook-Leg Veteran
description: A scarred pirate with a metal prosthetic leg, cutlass, and patched longcoat.

name: Twin-Pistol Ratliner
description: A nimble rigging fighter with paired flintlocks, belt hooks, and a close-cut coat.

name: Shipbreaker Mauler
description: A towering human raider wielding a two-handed boarding axe and layered shoulder leather.

name: Storm-Eye Lookout
description: A hooded lookout with storm goggles, a spyglass, and a short boarding spear.

name: Violet-Fuse Saboteur
description: A crouched saboteur carrying a violet fuse spool, hand charges, and a hooked knife.

name: Iron-Rib Captain's Guard
description: A disciplined human guard in ribbed blackened plate with a boarding glaive.

name: Gallows-Rope Snarer
description: A lean rope fighter with a weighted noose line, climbing harness, and face wrap.

name: Windlass Crossbowman
description: A compact deck crossbow specialist with a crank winch and stormproof cloak.

name: Salt-Rust Boarding Shield
description: A shield-bearing pirate with a battered round buckler and a short naval axe.

name: Veil-Cloaked Infiltrator
description: A silent human infiltrator with a dark split cloak, narrow mask, and paired daggers.

name: Lantern-Bomb Mechanic
description: A soot-smeared mechanic with a wrench, violet signal lantern, and patched tool belt.

name: Mourning-Coat Corsair
description: A pale-faced corsair in a long mourning coat with a curved sabre and brass buttons.

name: Tarred Sail-Ripper
description: A scarred sail-cutter with twin hooked knives and tarred canvas armor.

name: Copper-Goggle Powderman
description: A masked powderman with copper goggles, a stubby hand cannon, and spare cartridges.

name: Last-Ratline Enforcer
description: A relentless human enforcer with a cleaver-like cutlass and heavy climbing chains.

name: Admiral Veyl, the Black-Sail Overlord
description: A towering admiral in layered black sailcloth and grave steel, carrying a long violet-edged boarding blade.

name: Captain Sable Vane, Storm Widow
description: A human captain with a wind-torn mantle, brass storm mask, and paired dueling pistols.

name: The Hollow Commodore
description: A tall, fully humanoid corsair sealed inside an empty-looking black plate harness with a hooked polearm.

name: Madam Stormglass
description: A severe woman pirate with a violet compass cage, chart mantle, and ceremonial sabre.

name: The Gallows King
description: A massive human boarder in dangling chain harness and a broad executioner's boarding axe.

name: Brass-Beak, the Rookery Duelist
description: A masked human champion in brass beak visor, feathered collar, and long twin blades.

name: Red Gale Corsair
description: A ruthless human captain in a crimson stormcoat, gold trim, and a broad-backed cutlass.

name: Warden of the Rookery
description: A broad humanoid jailer with a locked iron cuirass, key chains, and a barbed boarding hook.

name: Lord Thundershroud
description: A human captain under a monumental ragged cloak, steel storm helm, and twin hand cannons.

name: The Last Boarding Saint
description: A towering human champion in tarnished gold and plum, carrying a banner-lance and cutlass.
